title: Európai és magyar irodalom- és zenetörténet (Consolidation)
grammar: Comprehensive review of the official European and Hungarian literary and musical canon

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: Consolidate all 30 vocabulary items on European and Hungarian literature, drama, and classical music.
Review author-to-work and composer-to-work pairings from the official Hungarian Cultural Knowledge Exam.
Read the complete synthesis on how European and Hungarian literary and musical masterpieces converse across history.
Demonstrate readiness for Category 3 of the Magyar kulturális ismereti vizsga.
